debutants_vegas124.json.compiled_by: Claude (card desk) for the forward-test ledger; input data, not a prediction file
debutants_vegas124.json.purpose: Pre-UFC records for the card's UFC debutants (slug null in cards_upcoming.json), in the shape that tools/preufc.py writes to data/derived/preufc.json fighters[slug], so the forward package can seed them: debut Elo = 1500 + elo_debut_shift (research/model_preufc.md, Recommendation 1), newcomer finish priors from finish_odds_multipliers (Recommendation 3) and the overall-level shift (Recommendation 4). Per Recommendation 5, add no pre-UFC term on top of a market line.
debutants_vegas124.json.method: Sherdog fighter pages fetched Nov 6, 2026, 21:03Z (User-Agent FightLabSim/1.0, one request per second or slower), parsed with tools/preufc.py parse_fighter and row_list. The debut snapshot is tools/preufc.py snapshot_feats + StrictNetwork.feats at the UFC bout date, run on the setup half of preufc.build() (cached Sherdog pages, promotion quality, full and strict networks; offline). A debutant's own page is not in the strict network, so net_elo_h is the tool's one-sided Elo walk over his own rows against opponents rated in network_C (C = Jan 1, 2026), the same treatment build() gives a fighter whose page is not in network_C. side_pre is tools/preufc.py side_pre(snapshot, 0). seeded_elo uses the live coefficients in preufc.json eval.models["seeded_elo_live (roster_priors; refit on every debut 2015-2025, vault excluded)"] (z = (x - mu) / sd, age_debut from the ufcstats DOB, which matches Sherdog's for all four). finish_odds_multipliers follow roster_priors(): (rate / mu_pre)^b with the n = 0 coefficients from eval.side_finish (n_UFC = 0, so at_debut = now). Amateur and exhibition fights are excluded from the record; no contests are counted in nc only.
debutants_vegas124.json.validation: The same script, run on five roster fighters' cached pages at their real UFC debut dates (Mitch Raposo, Alexia Thainara, Bogdan Grad, Cam Rowston, Bruno Lopes), reproduces their preufc.json debut snapshots exactly on every field, except age_pro_debut where build() used a ufcstats DOB that differs from Sherdog's (Thainara, Grad); elo_debut_shift matches roster_priors within 0.4 points (rounding of the stored mu and sd), apart from Thainara's DOB difference.
caveats: net_elo, opp_known and opp_wpct (no _h suffix) are the full-network reference values. A debutant's own page is not crawled, so they see only his fights against crawled fighters and are not comparable with roster values. The models use the strict versions (net_elo_h, opp_wpct_h, opp_known_h).
Sherdog's completeness for small regional shows is not measured (research/model_preufc.md, Caveats).

Tapology (403) and ufc.com (403) could not be fetched for a second full fight list; records were cross-checked against ESPN's records, the ufcstats DOBs and news reports instead (cross_checks per fighter).
These pages are not in data/raw/sherdog_cache (nothing there was changed). A later `tools/preufc.py crawl` will not pick them up either, because crawl targets only fighters with ufcstats bouts.

schema.fighters: key = slugified name used in the ledger's bout_id (slug is null in cards_upcoming.json)
schema.debut: the record entering the UFC as of the bout date, in preufc.json meta.snapshot_columns field names (see data/derived/preufc.json meta.fields), plus date and fid (null: no ufcstats fight id yet)
schema.fights: [date, result, method class, promotion, opponent, opponent sherdog id, round, 'UFC' or ''], oldest first (preufc.json fights format)
schema.record / last_fights: readable summary of the same data (last_fights newest first)
schema.derived.seeded_elo: elo_debut_shift (with age at UFC debut), elo_debut_shift_pre_only, debut_rating = 1500 + shift, and z-scores per key
schema.derived.finish_odds_multipliers: engine newcomer multipliers on per-fight odds: ko_win ~ power, sub_win ~ submission threat, ko_loss ~ chin (weak); fade by exp(-n_UFC / 8)
schema.also_upcoming: debutants on the next card (UFC 334), same shape
